title: Amazfit Verge with NFC sensor
symptom: The user is interested in using xDrip with the Amazfit Verge smartwatch, but the Verge is not included in the list of supported Amazfit devices. The user asks if it will be supported in the near future.
evidence_quote: Sorry i don't have a Verge, so i can't test it. NFC is also not relevant. The servicec for the amazfit watches only sends the data to a watchface and sends alarms. Nothing more. XDrip itself needs to run on the phone.
